author: willvelida
text: Critical RCE flaw in OpenCode that affects users on Windows and WSL that allows attacker-controlled remote MCP servers to execute code during MCP auth. No CVE has been published.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CVE-2023-54402 iDocView SSRF in /doc/upload; hardcoded token bypasses auth. Actively exploited since Mar 2024.

author: Python_s_
text: CVE-2025-54236 Adobe Commerce / Magento: VulnCheck reports real-world exploitation activity. Public PoC/exploit available; active exploitation reported.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: FortiSIEM vulnerability CVE-2026-106173 is exploited in the wild after Horizon3 released details and a PoC exploit. Upgrade to 7.5.1 now.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-109619: PHP core use-after-free, the second flaw in the php2shell chain with CVE-2026-109618. Unauthenticated RCE, CVSS 9.2

author: AinsworthKeith
text: Hackers hit Japan's GMO Internet cloud service used for automated forex trading: up to 26,739 servers compromised, credentials stolen, unauthorized trades at 70+ brokers. GMO shut the service down.

author: draginol
text: A number of well known SaaS got hacked last week. AI API keys en masse got leaked. Seeing reports of fraudulent use of these keys.

author: ThomasHuffman79
text: Unit 42 retracts AI-agent claim on PHP2Shell: walked back its claim about an AI agent being behind a break-in at a European government using PHP2Shell.

author: xingyuzhitong
text: Microsoft says Storm-0940 went from recon to privileged cloud access in under three hours with ARTEX, an agent-based pentest framework, partly via compromised ConnectWise apps that reached ~2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Collabora Online / Nextcloud CODE Server: active exploitation confirmed. CVE-2026-110447 (CISA KEV). Update richdocuments to .303 or later.

author: dailydotdev
text: Nobody agrees how much TiDB Cloud lost in its breach

author: ThreatAtlasIN
text: Arista says a flaw in VeloCloud Orchestrator (CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9) is being exploited. Update to 5.2.3.18 / 6.1.3.10 / 6.4.2.12.

author: iamnrdas
text: Public PoC details for CVE-2026-43501 (Linux kernel IPv6 RPL SRH OOB write, CVSS 9.8) released. Affects kernels since 5.7; fixed in recent stables like 6.6.140+.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-100794 (CVSS 9.6) sandbox escape in Firefox/Thunderbird Internationalization component. Patched in Firefox 157, ESR 153.4/140.17, Thunderbird 157/153.4/140.17.

author: Neome_com
text: Bitcoin Core drops its year-long embargo for bugs a single AI prompt can expose.

author: econographs
text: Hackers hijacked 850 GitHub accounts to leak their secrets: Wiz Research tracking campaign Gheist since Sept 15, using stolen GitHub tokens to plant a sync-check workflow in every reachable repo.

author: david_x_ai
text: On Oct 19, Pillar Security disclosed a critical bug in opencode, the open-source coding agent. On Windows and WSL, a remote MCP server could run code on your machine during OAuth sign-in.

author: rst_cloud
text: Threat report 2026-10-24 confirmed RCE: PHP honeypots hit via CVE-2026-109618 (CVSS 9.8), exploitation: true.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: GHEIST: STOLEN GITHUB TOKENS TURNED INTO A CI SECRET-THEFT CAMPAIGN. Wiz Research reports 13,500+ planted branches across 850+ compromised GitHub accounts since Sept 15, with the campaign still active and evolving as of Oct 24. The tool pushes a "sync-check" workflow that dumps CI secrets.

author: zoomeyebot
text: NLnet Labs NSD stack overwrite flaws: four CVEs, one zone-file parser trust boundary. Critical Vulnerability Alert! NLnet Labs NSD 4.10.0 through 4.15.2 is affected by CVE-2026-101341, CVE-2026-101339, CVE-2026-101338, CVE-2026-101337.

author: ZeroDayUSA
text: Japan's GMO Internet says the attacker behind its Desktop Cloud breach wants money. GMO refused and went to police. No attribution. (GMO notice)

author: HisashiSpace
text: How fast do attackers move after a critical bug goes public? With PHP2Shell, a PHP flaw affecting much of the web, Cloudflare saw hundreds of thousands of exploit attempts within about two hours of disclosure. Its CEO later reported the number had grown into the millions.

author: RedduxS
text: For those tracking the fallout from PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / 109619): a live challenge is putting $2,000+ behind a vulnerable PHP 8.4.26 container. My security team (a swarm of 100+ autonomous AI agent models) is currently pounding it.

author: neuralnotional
text: PHP2Shell: Amazon saw exploit attempts 4 days before PHP's critical RCE patches. Success on real systems is unconfirmed. Update to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35. Sources: PHP, AWS Security Blog

author: DreyXAI
text:
-Lightning AI shuts down Studio platform after credential breach
-AI coding agents hijacked via AGENTS.md file in Downloads
-PHP2Shell hits government entity amid AI-assisted hacking

author: raja_sudireddy
text: Japan's autumn breach wave now has a tool name attached, and it's an AI agent. This week GMO Cybersecurity by Ierae said the attackers used ARTEX, an open-source AI penetration testing tool built in China. Per Bloomberg, the attack infrastructure pointed almost only at Japan.

author: rodtrent
text: Security Check-in Quick Hits: OpenAI Agent Escapes via Cache Timing, LiteLLM Supply-Chain Hijack, CISA KEV Actively Exploited Flaws, and Brotli Decoder RCE Risks.

author: theblaze156
text: CrateDepression: Rust supply-chain attack infects cloud CI pipelines with Go malware via typosquatting, targeting GitLab CI users.

author: AlanHintonSP
text: A PHP bug that sat in the engine for 10+ years just became a full RCE chain. Researchers used GPT-5.6, Gemini 4 and Wiz's own AI agent to build the exploit, work that used to take weeks took under a day.

author: DefendtheFieldx
text: Handala Hack claims breach of the 'Etype' audio intel platform developed by Malam for Israeli security agencies (hacktivist claim, unverified).

author: TuringCyberObs
text: CVE-2021-48017 OrbiTeam BSCW Server unauthenticated path traversal is actively exploited in the wild and can expose local files, credentials and configuration data.

author: TuringCyberObs
text: Tier 1: CVE-2024-58393 i-Netsolution Readymade Unilevel Ecommerce MLM. Unauthenticated SQL injection is actively exploited in the wild.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Gheist campaign plants secret-dumping GitHub Actions workflows across 850+ compromised accounts, exfiltrating CI/CD secrets and cloud credentials through GitHub's own API. Active since September 15, 2026.

author: Paciva_ai
text: AI discovered a PHP vulnerability that could potentially impact 70% of websites worldwide. AI has uncovered critical vulnerabilities in PHP.

author: Stingrai_HQ
text: Snipe, our autonomous AI agent, found a CVE in Gitea. CVE-2026-58433: high-severity authorization bypass in Gitea 1.26.4 and earlier. Fixed in 1.27.0.

author: FarVisionNetwks
text: On Oct 23, CISA listed Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator CVE-2026-114625 (SQL injection on on-prem VCO) as actively exploited. Federal due date: Oct 26.

author: ShlomoFaig
text: This week in AI dev: OpenCode's hosted Console was breached Oct 18. 1.4% of Console users were hit, and their stored API keys were used for unauthorized charges.

author: gavinz0228
text: Cloudflare's CEO warns AI-discovered software bugs will make 'every single week feel like the sky is falling.' After this week's PHP and Node.js flaws, experts expect a 'vulnerability tsunami.'

author: secopschat
text: CVE-2026-85787 - An incomplete list of disallowed inputs in the SQL validation component in Amazon awslabs postgres-mcp-server allows modifying data beyond the read-only scope.

author: compuchris
text: Microsoft Issues Emergency Patch for Actively Exploited Critical WSUS Vulnerability.
